subject: Propagate SLIMbus NGD manager rejection to command callers
status: Host-validated candidate; not installed or physically qualified
behavior: CONNECT_SOURCE, CONNECT_SINK and DISCONNECT_PORT return -EIO when the manager response lacks bit 5.
DEF_ACT_CHAN, CHAN_CTRL and RECONFIG_NOW propagate the same rejection.
Clear status before each synchronous command so an empty reply cannot reuse prior success.
ADDR_QUERY replies contain enumeration-address data and bypass ACK checking.
A rejection received synchronously returns without dropping the runtime-PM vote a second time; the response callback already released it.
Synchronous helper releases the TID on pre-response failures; stream and address-query callers no longer release it again after a rejected response. The receive callback owns response-side release.
